name: KromiumAutomation
summary: Facade for DOM automation and browser interaction testing. Provides Playwright-style methods for automating interactions with the loaded page.

methods.name: emulateDesktopEnvironment
methods.signature: fun emulateDesktopEnvironment()
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the active page to normalize the headless environment and emulate a standard interactive desktop session.

methods.name: simulateClick
methods.signature: fun simulateClick(x: Int, y: Int)
methods.description: Simulates a click event at the specified viewport coordinates.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.signature: suspend fun waitForSelector(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Suspends until an element matching the CSS selector is attached to the DOM.

methods.name: waitForSelectorAsync
methods.signature: fun waitForSelectorAsync(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously awaits an element matching the CSS selector.

methods.name: waitForUrl
methods.signature: suspend fun waitForUrl(pattern: String, isRegex: Boolean = false, timeoutMs: Long = 15_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Suspends until current URL matches target pattern.

methods.name: waitForUrlAsync
methods.signature: fun waitForUrlAsync(pattern: String, isRegex: Boolean = false, timeoutMs: Long = 15_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously awaits matching URL.

methods.name: click
methods.signature: suspend fun click(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Clicks an element matching the CSS selector.

methods.name: clickAsync
methods.signature: fun clickAsync(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously clicks an element matching the CSS selector.

methods.name: fill
methods.signature: suspend fun fill(selector: String, value: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Sets the value of an input element matching the selector.

methods.name: fillAsync
methods.signature: fun fillAsync(selector: String, value: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the value of an input element.

methods.name: type
methods.signature: suspend fun type(selector: String, text: String, delayMs: Long = 20L, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Types text into an element character by character with keystroke delay.

methods.name: typeAsync
methods.signature: fun typeAsync(selector: String, text: String, delayMs: Long = 20L, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously types text into an element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.signature: suspend fun selectOption(selector: String, value: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Selects an option in a dropdown select element.

methods.name: selectOptionAsync
methods.signature: fun selectOptionAsync(selector: String, value: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously selects an option in a dropdown select element.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.signature: suspend fun getTextContent(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): String?
methods.description: Retrieves the inner text content of an element.

methods.name: getTextContentAsync
methods.signature: fun getTextContentAsync(selector: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<String?>
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the inner text content of an element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.signature: suspend fun getAttribute(selector: String, attribute: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): String?
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value of an element.

methods.name: getAttributeAsync
methods.signature: fun getAttributeAsync(selector: String, attribute: String, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<String?>
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an attribute value of an element.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.signature: suspend fun isVisible(selector: String): Boolean
methods.description: Checks if an element matching selector is visible.

methods.name: isVisibleAsync
methods.signature: fun isVisibleAsync(selector: String): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if an element is visible.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.signature: suspend fun isChecked(selector: String): Boolean
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio button is checked.

methods.name: isCheckedAsync
methods.signature: fun isCheckedAsync(selector: String): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a checkbox or radio button is checked.

methods.name: count
methods.signature: suspend fun count(selector: String): Int
methods.description: Returns the number of elements matching the selector.

methods.name: countAsync
methods.signature: fun countAsync(selector: String): CompletableFuture<Int>
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the number of elements matching the selector.
